response.sql:
WITH joined AS (
  SELECT 
    t.telescregistry,
    o.lunarstage,
    t.observstation,
    t.bandusagepct
  FROM telescopes t
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
),
station_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    lunarstage,
    observstation,
    AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bw
  FROM joined
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY lunarstage, observstation
),
phase_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    j.lunarstage,
    AVG(DISTINCT sa.avg_bw) AS avg_bandwidth,
    COUNT(DISTINCT j.telescregistry) AS telescope_count
  FROM joined j
  LEFT JOIN station_avgs sa 
    ON j.lunarstage = sa.lunarstage 
    AND j.observstation = sa.observstation
  GROUP BY j.lunarstage
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM joined
)
SELECT 
  ps.lunarstage AS phase,
  ps.avg_bandwidth,
  ps.telescope_count,
  ps.telescope_count * 1.0 / tc.total AS share
FROM phase_stats ps
CROSS JOIN total_count tc
ORDER BY ps.lunarstage NULLS LAST

assumptions.assumption: "Averaging per station first and then across stations" means computing AVG(bandwidth) per station for each phase, then averaging those distinct station-level averages. This gives equal weight to each station regardless of telescope count within it.
